items.distractor_fact: Á veðurstöðinni í næsta bæjarfélagi mældist hitinn {D}°C sama morgun.
items.gloss_en: At the weather station in the neighboring municipality, the temperature measured {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different weather station in a neighboring municipality, not the thermometer the story's temperatures come from.

items.distractor_fact: Á sama markaði kostaði hlutabréf í öðru fyrirtæki ${D} þennan dag.
items.gloss_en: On the same market, a share in another company cost ${D} that day.
items.entity_note: A different company's share price on the same market, not the company whose open/close price is compared.

items.distractor_fact: Í nágrannalóninu mældist vatnsborðið {D}m sama mánuð.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring reservoir, the water level measured {D} m that same month.
items.entity_note: A different, neighboring reservoir, not the reservoir whose water level is compared month to month.

items.distractor_fact: Annar dróni í sama leiðangri flaug í {D}m hæð á sama tíma.
items.gloss_en: Another drone in the same expedition flew at an altitude of {D} m at the same time.
items.entity_note: A different drone in the same expedition, not the drone whose altitude is measured at the two moments.

items.distractor_fact: Annar pakki í sömu sendingu vó {D}kg.
items.gloss_en: Another package in the same shipment weighed {D} kg.
items.entity_note: A different package within the same shipment, not the package weighed before and after the journey.

items.distractor_fact: Önnur vél í sömu verksmiðju mældist á {D}km/klst í sama prófi.
items.gloss_en: Another engine in the same factory measured {D} km/h in the same test.
items.entity_note: A different engine in the same factory, not the engine whose speed is compared across readings.

items.distractor_fact: Annar leikmaður í sama liði var kominn með {D}pts í lok setunnar.
items.gloss_en: Another player on the same team had reached {D} pts by the end of the session.
items.entity_note: A different player on the same team, not the player whose score is compared start to end.

items.distractor_fact: Annar viðskiptavinur í sama banka lagði inn ${D} þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: Another client at the same bank deposited ${D} that month.
items.entity_note: A different bank client, not the client whose account balance the question asks about.

items.distractor_fact: Annar félagi í sama klúbbi vann sér inn {D}pts þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: Another member of the same club earned {D} pts that month.
items.entity_note: A different club member, not the member whose points balance the question asks about.

items.distractor_fact: Önnur vörugeymsla í sömu keðju tók á móti birgðum sem námu {D}.
items.gloss_en: Another warehouse in the same chain received a stock count amounting to {D}.
items.entity_note: A different warehouse in the same chain, not the warehouse whose stock balance the question asks about.

items.distractor_fact: Önnur verslun í sömu verslunarkeðju hafði tekjur sem námu ${D} þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: Another shop in the same retail chain had income amounting to ${D} that month.
items.entity_note: A different shop in the same chain, not the shop whose net result the question asks about.

items.distractor_fact: Annað lið í sömu deild skoraði mörk sem námu {D} yfir tímabilið.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the same league scored goals amounting to {D} over the season.
items.entity_note: A different team in the same league, not the team whose goal difference the question asks about.

items.distractor_fact: Önnur lest á annarri leið kom {D}mín eftir miðnætti sama dag.
items.gloss_en: Another train on a different route arrived {D} min after midnight that same day.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different route with its own, unstated timetable, so the story's schedule does not apply to it.
